meta.title: 小小调色，拿捏啦🫴！！
meta.topic: 调色原理 · 三原色与减法

scenes.context: 夕阳想调更红，直接拉满红色很怪异，再拉满绿蓝反而变白。
sentences: 我想把这个夕阳调得更红。
I want to make this sunset redder.
make + 宾语 + 形容词比较级（把…变得更…）
Crank the red all the way up.
Why did it turn white instead?
scenes.speak: I want to make this sunset redder. Crank the red all the way up. It looks so weird. Why did it turn white instead?

scenes.context: 三原色两两叠加得三个新颜色，共六个互为对立的颜色，对立色混合变白。
sentences: These are the optical primary colors.
Six colors that oppose one another.
对立色混在一块，反而变成了白色。
Opposing colors mixed together turn white.
paraphrase: Pair them up and mix each duo.
Six colors, each with its own opposite.
scenes.speak: These are the optical primary colors. Combine them in pairs. Six colors that oppose one another. Opposing colors mixed together turn white.

scenes.context: 照片发灰不显色，是对立色混进来了——抽走对立色，颜色自然透出。
sentences: The photo looks washed out and gray.
不是你想要的颜色不够多。
It's not that your color is lacking.
而是它的对立色混进来了。
It's that its opposite has mixed in.
调色不是做加法，而是做减法。
Grading is about subtraction, not addition.
paraphrase: The image looks flat and colorless.
Don't add color — remove what's muddying it.
scenes.speak: The photo looks washed out and gray. It's not that your color is lacking. It's that its opposite has mixed in. Grading is about subtraction, not addition.

scenes.title_en: A Redder Sunset: Cut Blue and Green
scenes.context: 红色的对立色是青色（蓝+绿），比起加红更重要的是减蓝和绿。
sentences: 不是要加红色，而是要减去它的对立色。
Don't add red; subtract its opposite.
青色是蓝和绿混合得到的。
Cyan is made by mixing blue and green.
更重要的是减去蓝和绿。
What matters more is cutting the blue and green.
paraphrase: The complement of red is cyan. · complement（补色）
The key is to pull out the blue and green.
scenes.speak: Don't add red; subtract its opposite. Red's opposite is cyan. Cyan is made by mixing blue and green. What matters more is cutting the blue and green.

scenes.context: 调橙色看距离：离最近的红少减，离最远的蓝多减。
sentences: 如果我想调的是橙色呢？
What if I want orange instead of pure red?
Just remember: near, less; far, more.
近少远多=near less, far more
把世界调成任意你想要的颜色。
You can turn the world any color you want.
any color you want（任意颜色）
paraphrase: It comes down to how far each color sits.
Cut the nearby colors a little, the far ones a lot.
scenes.speak: What if I want orange instead of pure red? It's all about distance. Orange is closest to red. Just remember: near, less; far, more. You can turn the world any color you want.

practice: The photo looks washed out and gray.
调色不是做加法，而是做减法。
Grading is about subtraction, not addition.
pitfalls: 红色更红用比较级 redder，不用 more red
Opposing colors mixed together turn white.
mixed together 是过去分词短语，作后置定语
Not enough of your color, it's the opposite.
It's not that your color is lacking — it's the opposite.
it's not that...it's that... 是固定句式
Cyan is mixed by blue and green.
Cyan is made by mixing blue and green.
be made by + doing 才表示「由…混合而成」
shifts: 先抽走混进来的对立色
拉满反而变白，补色抵消
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：视频原文「披的更红」「披个图」为「调」的同音误记，正文统一为「调」。
